description: Refuses every customer refund. Caller-declared signals (refundEligible, fraudCheckPassed, managerApproved) can no longer authorize money movement, so this policy has no approve rule. Refunds on Razorpay payments go through razorpay-refund, which checks the payment with Razorpay. Refunds on other rails need their own verified signal and policy before they can be authorized.

outcome.reason: Refund rejected. customer-refund no longer authorizes refunds. Use razorpay-refund for Razorpay payments. Other payment rails need a verified signal before a refund can be authorized.
